entry.title: Missions
entry.summary: Short mission write-ups for the example docsite, one page per mission.
entry.content:
Each page in this folder describes one mission planned for the example site: what it sets out to change and why. They are forward-looking write-ups, not a record of the current state (see Architecture for that).

This index page also gives the folder its name in the sidebar. A nested folder is labelled with the title of its index page, so without this page the group would fall back to a readable form of the folder name and the build would report the missing title.
